FAST

Oct 29 : The Atlanta Dream beat the Golden State Valkyries 80-69 on Thursday in a matinee performance worthy of primetime billing, forcing a Game 7 in the WNBA Finals and bringing the party atmosphere back after frustration over scheduling issues.
A sellout crowd of 17,000 showed up at 12:30 pm ET at State Farm Arena, after conflicts with the Dream's NBA counterparts Atlanta Hawks forced them into a midday, midweek time slot. 
The Dream, who do not share an owner with the Hawks, have played their postseason games at the Hawks' State Farm Arena after their 3,500-seat home was widely considered inadequate for the overwhelming interest in their first trip to the Finals since 2013.
"You could definitely tell we got our swagger back," said Angel Reese, who produced 15 points, 14 rebounds and six assists.

"Shout out to the crowd. Being able to come here, 12:30 on a Thursday - so many things going on in the world from school, to work, to everything else - we're just super thankful."
Their win spared the WNBA the awkward optics of crowning a champion in the middle of a weekday afternoon, as Valkyries' fans back in the Bay were forced to tune in at 9:30 am PT to cheer on the young team's quest for a first-ever title.
In a widely reported open letter this week, the Dream said that concerns over the schedule clash with the Hawks' regular season game against the Cleveland Cavaliers did not get the "attention, nor the urgency that they deserved" from the WNBA.
The saga was a frustration for fans and players in a series that otherwise delivered plenty to celebrate: The Finals have drawn record viewership, with an average of 2.1 million tuning in for Game 1. 
"I had no doubt that (the fans) would show up," said Rhyne Howard, whose first-half hot streak propelled Atlanta to a 20-point lead headed into the locker room. 
"Now they can leave with a better taste in their mouth - get the bottomless mimosas, enjoy the rest of their day, because I know nobody's going back to work."

Source: Reuters

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ上昇、ＥＣＢ据え置きも12月利上げに含み
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が金利据え置きを決定したものの１２月の利上げに含みを残したことを受け、ユーロが上昇した。ドルは経済指標でインフレ加速が示されたことでおおむね軟調。円は日銀が３１日に発表する金融政策決定会合の結果が注目される中、対ドルでほぼ横ばいで推移した。

ＥＣＢはこの日に開いた理事会で、予想通りに金利据え置きを決定。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。ＥＣＢはまた、ラガルド総裁が来年２月７日に退任すると発表。任期は２７年１０月までだった。

ソルトマーシュ・エコノミクスの欧州担当エコノミスト、マルシェル・アレクサンドロビッチ氏は「ＥＣＢは予想通りに金利を据え置いたが、インフレ見通しの上振れリスクを挙げ、１２月の利上げが十分にあり得ることを示唆した」と指摘。「金利据え置きよりも、ラガルド総裁が来年１０月ではなく２月に退任すると発表されたことが大きなニュースだった」とし、１月初めに退任するイザベル・シュナーベル専務理事と、５月に退任予定のフィリップ・レーン専務理事兼チーフエコノミストに言及し、「（ラガルド氏の早期退任は）市場にとって驚きではなかったが、ＥＣＢが２０２７年前半に大規模な人事刷新を迎えることが改めて意識される」と述べた。

ユーロは対ドルで一時５月以来の安値を付けたものの、その後は上向き、終盤の取引で０．１３％高の１．１１６７ドル。

日銀は２９─３０日の金融政策決定会合で金利据え置きを決定すると広く予想されている。バンク・オブ・アメリカのイズミ・デバリエ氏らアナリストは投資家向けリポートで「日銀の政策決定会合で円相場が大きく動くとは予想していないが、基調的なインフレ圧力が根強いことを踏まえると、タカ派的な反対票が複数出れば円高方向の反応が強まる可能性がある」とした。

終盤の取引で円は対ドル で０．０５％安の１５７．９１円。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２８日までの２日間の日程で開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で金利据え置きを決定。１１月３日に中間選挙を控える中、インフレ動向に関する一段のデータを見極める姿勢を示した。ただ、商務省がこの日に発表した９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。ＦＲＢが１２月の次回会合で追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まった。

ＣＭＥフェドウォッチによると、ＦＲＢが１２月の会合で利上げを決定する確率は約８０％。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１４％安の１０１．９８。

高値 158.12

安値 157.65

始値 1.1148

高値 1.1185

安値 1.1106

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が金利据え置きを決定し...
items.body:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ユーロ上昇、ＥＣＢ据え置きも12月利上げに含み
6:07 配信

２０２２年４月撮影　REUTERS/Maxim Shemetov（ロイター） ［ニューヨーク／ロンドン　２９日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が金利据え置きを決定したものの１２月の利上げに含みを残したことを受け、ユーロが上昇した。ドルは経済指標でインフレ加速が示されたことでおおむね軟調。円は日銀が３１日に発表する金融政策決定会合の結果が注目される中、対ドルでほぼ横ばいで推移した。

ＥＣＢはこの日に開いた理事会で、予想通りに金利据え置きを決定。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。ＥＣＢはまた、ラガルド総裁が来年２月７日に退任すると発表。任期は２７年１０月までだった。

ソルトマーシュ・エコノミクスの欧州担当エコノミスト、マルシェル・アレクサンドロビッチ氏は「ＥＣＢは予想通りに金利を据え置いたが、インフレ見通しの上振れリスクを挙げ、１２月の利上げが十分にあり得ることを示唆した」と指摘。「金利据え置きよりも、ラガルド総裁が来年１０月ではなく２月に退任すると発表されたことが大きなニュースだった」とし、１月初めに退任するイザベル・シュナーベル専務理事と、５月に退任予定のフィリップ・レーン専務理事兼チーフエコノミストに言及し、「（ラガルド氏の早期退任は）市場にとって驚きではなかったが、ＥＣＢが２０２７年前半に大規模な人事刷新を迎えることが改めて意識される」と述べた。

ユーロは対ドルで一時５月以来の安値を付けたものの、その後は上向き、終盤の取引で０．１３％高の１．１１６７ドル。

日銀は２９─３０日の金融政策決定会合で金利据え置きを決定すると広く予想されている。バンク・オブ・アメリカのイズミ・デバリエ氏らアナリストは投資家向けリポートで「日銀の政策決定会合で円相場が大きく動くとは予想していないが、基調的なインフレ圧力が根強いことを踏まえると、タカ派的な反対票が複数出れば円高方向の反応が強まる可能性がある」とした。

終盤の取引で円は対ドル で０．０５％安の１５７．９１円。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２８日までの２日間の日程で開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で金利据え置きを決定。１１月３日に中間選挙を控える中、インフレ動向に関する一段のデータを見極める姿勢を示した。ただ、商務省がこの日に発表した９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、伸びは８月の３．４％から加速。ＦＲＢが１２月の次回会合で追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まった。

ＣＭＥフェドウォッチによると、ＦＲＢが１２月の会合で利上げを決定する確率は約８０％。

主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．１４％安の１０１．９８。

Weak quarter for Intel sends shivers through cooling chip stocks

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 29 : Chip stocks took another hit after Thursday's weak quarterly earnings report from Intel, which could make for interesting dynamics when trading reopens on Friday.
The semiconductor index sold off in post-close trading on Thursday after chipmaker Intel blamed "near term headwinds across the PC industry," sending its shares tumbling 18 per cent in the after-hours session. That followed the SOX's 1.4 per cent drop during the regular session due to a messy earnings report from big AI spender Alphabet on Wednesday.
Intel said a factory explosion in Israel will cost it roughly $600 million in lost revenue over two quarters because it has been shut down for about two weeks. Intel's fall took other big chip stocks down in post-close trading as well. 
"Overall semis weakness after hours is primarily a function of INTC guide and negative sentiment spillover," said Michael James, equity sales trader at Rosenblatt Securities.

Intel's problems in the PC sector, an area of technology that does not garner the same scrutiny on Wall Street as the AI buildout, does not seem to necessarily mean big problems for other chipmakers that operate more prominently in AI.
Nevertheless, investors in the less-active post-market trade chose to shoot first and ask questions later. AMD dropped 4 per cent and Broadcom fell 2 per cent. Among the biggest losers in the volatile session were the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull ETF, which offers investors three times the daily performance of the SOX and was off 9 per cent.
"The revenues missed due to lower PC demand and forward guidance also disappointed. As Google learned today, earnings matter," said Kim Caughey Forrest, founder and chief investment officer at Bokeh Capital Partners LLC. Google parent Alphabet dropped 13 per cent on Thursday.
The SOX has been one of 2026's standout performers, rising more than 60 per cent as shortages of chips and equipment needed for the AI buildout drive up prices and profits at firms ranging from giant Nvidia and memory chip firm Micron to Marvell Technology. 
But the momentum of that trade has been tested over the past month by tightening financing terms. That has kept some expected IPOs on the sidelines and put some highly leveraged AI infrastructure firms under pressure. The SOX has declined 13 per cent since hitting its recent high in October and is off 21 per cent from its all-time high in June. 
That said, pre- and after-market trading often exaggerates moves relative to those in the more liquid regular session, particularly for stocks affected by a rival's news. 
"I think it should not have much of an effect on the market," said Caughey Forrest. "It sounds like it was a PC issue. AMD may be a target for selling tomorrow too. Intel does not have much to do with AI, which is why the market might ignore it."

Source: Reuters

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 30 : The Bank of Japan is set to keep interest rates steady on Friday but stress its focus on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target, suggesting scope to hike borrowing costs as soon as December.
Such guidance would reinforce the central bank's message last month that it has entered a new, more hawkish policy phase and is open to raising rates once every few months, analysts said.
The pivot would also align the BOJ with its US and European counterparts eyeing near-term rate hikes to battle inflationary risks from the AI boom and the Iran war-induced energy shock.
"Global price pressures from AI investment are quite strong, which means the recent inflation is partly demand driven," said Kazuo Momma, a former BOJ executive who is currently executive economist at Mizuho Research Institute.

"By declaring that its policy phase has changed, the BOJ is essentially telling markets it will hike rates once a quarter," he said, predicting rate hikes in December and March next year.
At the two-day meeting ending on Friday, the BOJ is set to maintain its policy rate at 1.25 per cent, forgoing a back-to-back hike to spend more time scrutinising the effect of past rate hikes on lending conditions.
In a quarterly report, the BOJ is likely to slightly revise up next fiscal year's price forecast and signal that underlying inflation has roughly achieved its 2 per cent target, people familiar with the matter have told Reuters.
With wage gains becoming embedded and inflation expectations hovering around 2 per cent, the central bank will likely stress that it will now focus on anchoring inflation around its target by raising rates toward levels deemed neutral to the economy.
Markets will scrutinise comments from Governor Kazuo Ueda's post-meeting news conference for hints on the pace and timing of further rate hikes.
"If the BOJ were to say underlying inflation reached levels consistent with its 2 per cent price target, that would have important policy implications," said former BOJ official Nobuyasu Atago, who is currently chief economist at Rakuten Securities Economic Research Institute.
"It would be a show of resolve the BOJ won't tolerate any further overshoot in inflation," and signal the chance of more nimble rate hikes next year, he said.
With stubbornly high energy costs and rising import prices from a weak yen adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised rates in September after delivering a hike in June - a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes in 2024 and 2025.
Most analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent in December, followed by further hikes next year. Their terminal rate projection centres around 1.75 per cent to 2 per cent.
Core consumer inflation exceeded the BOJ's 2 per cent target in September for the first time in nine months, as high fuel costs from the prolonged Middle East conflict blunt the impact of government fuel subsidies.
In current quarterly projections made in July, the BOJ expects consumer inflation to accelerate in coming months as firms continue to pass on rising costs.

Source: Reuters

Bank of Japan to hold rates, signal further hikes

FAST

TOKYO, Oct 30 : The Bank of Japan is set to keep interest rates steady on Friday but stress its focus on preventing underlying inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target, suggesting scope to hike borrowing costs as soon as December.
Such guidance would reinforce the central bank's message last month that it has entered a new, more hawkish policy phase and is open to raising rates once every few months, analysts said.
The pivot would also align the BOJ with its US and European counterparts eyeing near-term rate hikes to battle inflationary risks from the AI boom and the Iran war-induced energy shock.
"Global price pressures from AI investment are quite strong, which means the recent inflation is partly demand driven," said Kazuo Momma, a former BOJ executive who is currently executive economist at Mizuho Research Institute.

"By declaring that its policy phase has changed, the BOJ is essentially telling markets it will hike rates once a quarter," he said, predicting rate hikes in December and March next year.
At the two-day meeting ending on Friday, the BOJ is set to maintain its policy rate at 1.25 per cent, forgoing a back-to-back hike to spend more time scrutinising the effect of past rate hikes on lending conditions.
In a quarterly report, the BOJ is likely to slightly revise up next fiscal year's price forecast and signal that underlying inflation has roughly achieved its 2 per cent target, people familiar with the matter have told Reuters.
With wage gains becoming embedded and inflation expectations hovering around 2 per cent, the central bank will likely stress that it will now focus on anchoring inflation around its target by raising rates toward levels deemed neutral to the economy.
Markets will scrutinise comments from Governor Kazuo Ueda's post-meeting news conference for hints on the pace and timing of further rate hikes.
"If the BOJ were to say underlying inflation reached levels consistent with its 2 per cent price target, that would have important policy implications," said former BOJ official Nobuyasu Atago, who is currently chief economist at Rakuten Securities Economic Research Institute.
"It would be a show of resolve the BOJ won't tolerate any further overshoot in inflation," and signal the chance of more nimble rate hikes next year, he said.
With stubbornly high energy costs and rising import prices from a weak yen adding to inflationary pressures, the BOJ raised rates in September after delivering a hike in June - a shorter interval than the roughly twice-a-year hikes in 2024 and 2025.
Most analysts polled by Reuters expect the BOJ to raise its policy rate to 1.5 per cent in December, followed by further hikes next year. Their terminal rate projection centres around 1.75 per cent to 2 per cent.
Core consumer inflation exceeded the BOJ's 2 per cent target in September for the first time in nine months, as high fuel costs from the prolonged Middle East conflict blunt the impact of government fuel subsidies.
In current quarterly projections made in July, the BOJ expects consumer inflation to accelerate in coming months as firms continue to pass on rising costs.

Source: Reuters

items.title: エヌビディアＣＥＯ、シンガポール企業との取引擁護　元幹部に中国スパイ疑惑＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手のエヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、シンガポールに拠点を置くメガスピード・インターナショナルとの取引を擁護し、「通常のことであり、異例ではない」と述べた。ブルームバーグ・ニュースが２９日報じた。

これに先立ち、ニューヨーク・タイムズ（ＮＹＴ）は、メガスピードの元幹部の１人が中国のためにスパイ活動をした疑いで米当局の捜査を受けていると報じていた。 

ブルームバーグ・ニュースによると、フアン氏は、メガスピード幹部との関係は適切なものであり、メガスピードがエヌビディアの人工知能（ＡＩ）チップを中国に不正に出荷していないことを確認していたと説明。「われわれは当社の画像処理装置（ＧＰＵ）の配備状況を全て調べ、一つ残らず確認した」と述べた。 

ＮＹＴの報道によると、フアン氏は、この元幹部とのやり取りは中国の顧客や経営幹部との典型的なものであり、この人物はすでにメガスピードを退社していると語った。同報道によると、エヌビディアは、米国の輸出規制があるにもかかわらず、同社の先端ＡＩチップの中国への密輸は重大な問題ではないと主張しているという。

items.title: Canada could transition to full renewables by 2050, expert tells youth climate trial
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: It is “definitely” possible for Canada to transition to full renewable energy by 2050, an expert in environmental engineering and atmospheric science has told the country’s first youth-led climate ...
items.body: It is “definitely” possible for Canada to transition to full renewable energy by 2050, an expert in environmental engineering and atmospheric science has told the country’s first youth-led climate trial in Vancouver. Stanford University professor Mark Jacobson said the shift is technically and economically feasible — but there are social and political obstacles. Jacobson has developed sophisticated models and road maps to help cities, states and countries, including Canada, make the shift to renewable energy. Canada does not need to rely on fossil fuels, he testified Thursday, as he outlined how the country could meet its energy demands by tapping “humongous” resources and opportunities in wind, solar and geothermal, along with pre-existing hydroelectric capacity. Combine that with the electrification of energy and transportation and “Canada can do it,” Jacobson said of transitioning to renewables. “Whether it actually does it by 2050 is more of a social and political question.” Jacobson is a witness for 15 young plaintiffs in the trial underway in Federal Court in Vancouver, where they are arguing that federal legislation violates their constitutional rights by continuing Canada’s trajectory of greenhouse gas emissions. Electricity is significantly more efficient than combustion, Jacobson said. “By electrifying everything and providing that electricity from renewables, you use a huge amount less energy. In Canada, it’s like 60 per cent less energy,” he said. “There’s no more combustion, so you eliminate the air pollutants, you eliminate the global warming emissions.” Shifting to renewable energy would help avert deaths and cut the health costs associated with fossil fuels, Jacobson told the hearing. He said an estimated 6,900 people die each year from air pollution in Canada. The plaintiffs’ lawyer, Catherine Boies Parker, told the court in her opening statement the case was not about the existence of climate change. Rather, it hinges on whether the government is “constitutionally required to stop making it worse,” she said. “The plaintiffs are asking this court to hold Canada legally accountable for its role in continuing and worsening the climate crisis that is causing harm.” This report by Brenna Owen, The Canadian Press, was first published Oct. 29, 2026.

items.title: Amazon dispara su inversión en infraestructura para IA mientras sus ingresos crecen 12%
items.author: Matt Day
items.summary: El gigante tecnológico reportó ingresos por US$201.900 millones en el tercer trimestre, mientras AWS aceleró sus ventas por sexto trimestre consecutivo y el negocio minorista mostró señales de desacel ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) registró un gasto de capital mayor del previsto, mientras que los ingresos del comercio electrónico se ralentizaron y las perspectivas de la compañía para las ventas navideñas indicaron que el negocio en línea no está preparado para una rápida recuperación. Amazon anunció que gastó más de US$77.000 millones en propiedades y equipos durante el tercer trimestre, una cifra muy superior a las estimaciones de los analistas, en el marco de sus esfuerzos por construir centros de datos y satisfacer la demanda de servicios de inteligencia artificial. El gasto de la empresa provocó una salida de efectivo libre de US$42.400 millones. La empresa también informó de que sus ingresos aumentaron un 12%, hasta alcanzar los US$201.900 millones. Aunque las ventas de su unidad de nube, Amazon Web Services, se aceleraron por sexto trimestre consecutivo, se observaron signos de un crecimiento lento en su negocio principal en línea. Ver más: Amazon renueva Alexa con nuevos Echo, un reloj inteligente y un marco de fotos digital Si bien los ingresos de su unidad de computación en la nube, Amazon Web Services, se aceleraron por sexto trimestre consecutivo, se observaron señales de un crecimiento lento en sus negocios principales. Las ventas en línea aumentaron apenas un 2%, hasta alcanzar los US$68.500 millones, la tasa de crecimiento más baja desde principios de 2023, cuando Amazon aún lidiaba con la recesión del comercio minorista en línea posterior a la pandemia. El negocio de AWS ha repuntado este año, impulsado por las ventas a empresas de inteligencia artificial como OpenAI y Anthropic, que dependen en parte de los servidores de Amazon para el funcionamiento de sus modelos. Amazon también ha ampliado su red de centros de datos, aumentando así su capacidad para proporcionar potencia informática a las empresas. Ver más: El salario promedio que Amazon ofrecerá a sus trabajadores temporales para la Navidad 2026 La compañía anunció en julio que probablemente invertiría US$220.000 millones en gastos de capital en 2026, una cifra superior a la previsión anterior, debido a la escasez de chips de memoria que limitó la oferta. Amazon mantuvo esa previsión el jueves. Las acciones cayeron más del 5% en las operaciones posteriores al cierre, tras haber cerrado a US$243,79 en Nueva York. Hasta el cierre del jueves, la cotización había subido un 5,6% en lo que va del año. La decepción de los inversores con los resultados de Amazon es similar a la reacción ante el informe de su rival Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ) publicado el miércoles. Alphabet reportó ventas de búsqueda y publicidad que reforzaron las preocupaciones de los inversores sobre la amenaza que representa la IA para su negocio principal, lo que provocó una caída del 13% en el precio de sus acciones al cierre del jueves, el peor día de su historia para la compañía. items.title: Habla colombiano que sobrevivió al accidente de trenes en España
items.author: Carlos Cuevas
items.summary: Un colombiano de 53 años que viajaba en el séptimo vagón del tren operado por Iryo relató cómo vivió la colisión, ayudó a evacuar a otros pasajeros y comprendió la magnitud del accidente al llegar a u ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — Jorge Guales, un colombiano que figura entre los sobrevivientes del siniestro entre dos trenes de alta velocidad en España, registrado antes de las 9 de la mañana del miércoles en la ciudad de Toledo, brindó su testimonio de lo sucedido. Guales, de 53 años, viajaba en el séptimo vagón del tren operado por la empresa hispano-italiana Iryo, adversaria de la estatal española Renfe , también involucrada en el accidente que deja 69 muertos, y explicó a Europa Press que su ubicación le permitió salir ileso. Lo primero que pensaron tanto él como algunos pasajeros fue que “habían chocado”, pero no estaba seguros porque el humo tras la colisión les impedía observar lo ocurrido. “Mucha gente se golpeó y se cayó”, relató el colombiano a la agencia de noticias. “Muchos objetos personales rodaron por el piso del vagón”. Ver más: BBVA aumenta sus ganancias mientras México compensa la debilidad en España Luego de haberse repuesto del shock inicial, Guales y quienes estaban ilesos ayudaron a los demás a evacuar el vagón, salvo unos casos: hubo personas a las que, por la aparente gravedad de sus heridas, prefirieron no mover. “No tuvimos necesidad de romper vidrios porque se abrió una puerta, entonces salimos como tres personas y empezamos a ayudar a la gente a que evacuara”, agregó en la conversación con Europa Press . Solo después de haber dejado el tren y caminado hacia una zona boscosa, donde fue atendido por personal de la Guardia Civil, comprendió la dimensión de lo sucedido. “Vimos el accidente, vimos que fue bastante fuerte”, describió. “Fue bastante duro”. El presidente del Gobierno español, Pedro Sánchez, prometió llevar a cabo una investigación exhaustiva del accidente ferroviario, el incidente de este tipo más mortífero en el país en más de una década. “Si hubo negligencia, lo averiguaremos”, dijo Sánchez tras visitar el lugar del accidente. “Si hubo fallos en el sistema de seguridad, responderemos con contundencia”. El ministro de Transportes español, Óscar Puente, explicó que la colisión se produjo después de que un centro de control ferroviario ordenara por error a un tren de alta velocidad que reanudara la marcha mientras otros se encontraban parados, lo que provocó que se estrellara contra la parte trasera de un tren parado. El accidente tuvo lugar a unos 129 kilómetros al sur de Madrid. Ver más: España flexibiliza las reglas energéticas para centros de datos, un triunfo para las grandes tecnológicas “Estamos absolutamente consternados; este es uno de los momentos más difíciles a los que nos podemos enfrentar”, declaró Puente ante la prensa en Madrid. El accidente es la catástrofe ferroviaria más mortífera de España desde 2013, cuando fallecieron 80 personas tras el descarrilamiento de un tren en la región de Galicia, al norte de Madrid. Otra colisión ocurrida el pasado mes de enero también se cobró la vida de más de 40 personas, lo que provocó un intenso escrutinio de la infraestructura ferroviaria española, que en su día se consideraba un motivo de orgullo nacional. -- Con información de Bloomberg News

items.title: Hasta 40 años de cárcel por grafitis: detalles de la ley contra maras y pandillas que aprobó Honduras
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: El Congreso Nacional aprobó un paquete de reformas penales que establece condenas de entre 30 y 40 años de cárcel para integrantes de estructuras criminales, y contempla la prisión perpetua para respo ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El Congreso Nacional de Honduras aprobó este martes en único debate un paquete de reformas penales que endurece las sanciones contra las maras y pandillas, con penas de entre 30 y 40 años de prisión para sus integrantes y cadena perpetua para sus cabecillas y para quienes recluten menores de edad. Ver más: Costa Rica inaugura el Cacco, su primera megacárcel, con capacidad para 5.100 reclusos La Ley Especial para el Fortalecimiento del Marco Penal y Procesal en el Combate a Asociaciones Terroristas, Maras y Pandillas modifica el Código Penal, el Código Procesal Penal y la Ley del Sistema Penitenciario Nacional, y fue respaldada por 118 votos a favor, mientras que 10 diputados del Partido Libertad y Refundación (Libre) se abstuvieron. La iniciativa, impulsada por el Consejo Nacional de Defensa y Seguridad que preside el mandatario hondureño Nasry Asfura, llegó al pleno sin cambios sustanciales pese a las observaciones que había formulado la Corte Suprema de Justicia (CSJ). Las principales pandillas del país son la Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) y el Barrio 18, presentes desde hace más de tres décadas y con unos 40.000 afiliados, según las autoridades, que las vinculan con la extorsión y el narcotráfico. Honduras registró 2.629 homicidios en 2025, de acuerdo con cifras oficiales. La reforma del artículo 587 del Código Penal fija condenas de 30 a 40 años para los integrantes de estas organizaciones, mientras que sus líderes y quienes las financien podrán recibir de 40 años a prisión perpetua. Ver más: El Estado de Derecho sigue deteriorándose en el mundo: qué revela índice sobre América Latina Para quienes colaboren con estas estructuras sin pertenecer a ellas, el artículo 588 establece penas de 20 a 30 años de prisión y multas, sanción que sube de 30 a 40 años si el autor es funcionario público o actúa a cambio de una recompensa. El asesinato de un funcionario de justicia o de seguridad por razón de su cargo se castigará con prisión perpetua, y los atentados contra la autoridad con penas de ocho a diez años. También serán sancionados con 30 a 40 años quienes elaboren, difundan o coloquen grafitis y mensajes relacionados con amenazas, intimidación o control territorial. La pertenencia a estas organizaciones podrá acreditarse mediante tatuajes, símbolos o expresiones características, sin que la ley especifique cuáles. Además, se amplía la definición de asociación terrorista para incluir conductas como someter actividades económicas o de transporte a monopolios de hecho, cobros ilegales o restricciones a la libre circulación de bienes, servicios o personas. En el terreno procesal, los imputados por asociación terrorista quedarán sujetos a prisión preventiva obligatoria, sin acceso a medidas alternativas, y el juez deberá ordenarla de oficio. El plazo para que el Ministerio Público presente su requerimiento tras la detención pasará de 24 a 48 horas —en casos de asociación terrorista, narcotráfico, secuestro y extorsión—, con el argumento oficial de que el requerimiento llegue respaldado “por pruebas suficientes”. La norma autoriza además allanamientos y registros de domicilios sin orden judicial previa, en coordinación con un fiscal, durante operaciones contra estas organizaciones cuando existan indicios fundados y urgentes de que en el inmueble se ocultan integrantes, armas o explosivos, o de que evidencias pueden ser destruidas o alteradas. “No es que van a ir a cualquier casa solo por ir”, precisó el presidente del Congreso Nacional, Tomás Zambrano, durante la sesión. Las reformas también darán paso a la creación de una Fuerza Especial Penitenciaria, unidad que será parte de la estructura del Instituto Nacional Penitenciario (INP) y estará a cargo de custodiar los módulos de máxima seguridad, ejecutar traslados de alto riesgo y responder ante motines y fugas. La ley dispone también identificación biométrica obligatoria, nuevas restricciones para reclusos en regímenes especiales, la eliminación de símbolos alusivos a maras en barrios y colonias, y penas de cuatro a seis años para quien vuele drones sobre centros penales. El texto incorpora la llamada Ley Casa Segura, que exime de responsabilidad penal a quien actúe contra un extraño sorprendido dentro de su vivienda o que intente ingresar a un domicilio o negocio mediante violencia o intimidación. El Ejecutivo deberá adecuar los reglamentos penitenciarios en un plazo máximo de 30 días, y la normativa entrará en vigor con su publicación en el diario oficial La Gaceta. Zambrano afirmó que es la cuarta reforma en materia de seguridad del actual período legislativo y anticipó que el Congreso solicitará informes sobre los resultados de su aplicación. “Desde este Congreso no vamos a descansar hasta que Honduras recupere la paz y la seguridad” dijo. “El pueblo hondureño merece vivir sin miedo”. La sesión contó con la presencia del presidente de la CSJ, Wagner Vallecillo, y de mandos de la Policía Nacional, la Policía Militar del Orden Público y el sistema penitenciario. El director policial, Rigoberto Oseguera, se comprometió a aplicar la norma con rigor y sin “mala praxis”, mientras el diputado Kilvett Bertrand sostuvo que las reformas buscan recuperar la tranquilidad de la población y enfrentar la extorsión. El pleno de la CSJ había recomendado garantizar el debido proceso, la presunción de inocencia y la supervisión judicial de los allanamientos, observaciones que el Legislativo aprobó sin incorporar. El dictamen se conoció apenas veinte minutos antes del debate, según denunció el diputado opositor Hugo Noé Pino, cuyo suplente se abstuvo de votar. En entrevista a Criterio.hn , el legislador calificó el paquete de “atentado al derecho a la protesta” y lo inscribió en un “populismo punitivo de derecha”. En tanto, el abogado constitucionalista Joaquín Mejía señaló en X que al ignorar la opinión de la CSJ, un mecanismo de control preventivo de constitucionalidad, el Congreso “demuestra su carácter autoritario” y sigue la estela de Nicaragua, donde las reformas penales se han usado para reprimir voces críticas. “Existe el peligro que, con una noción tan vaga y amplia de terrorismo, se acuse de “terroristas” -igual que en Nicaragua- a quienes defienden los territorios, los bienes comunes y tienen una postura crítica frente al uso arbitrario del poder", agregó. Las reformas se suman a las medidas de endurecimiento penitenciario aprobadas en septiembre y replican el modelo aplicado en El Salvador desde marzo de 2022 bajo el régimen de excepción, e cual se ha prorrogado en 56 ocasiones. Ver más: Perú explora la fórmula de Bukele contra el crimen: Fujimori se reunirá con él y visitará el Cecot Una delegación legislativa encabezada por Zambrano visitó el 16 de octubre el Centro de Confinamiento del Terrorismo (Cecot) y anunció que estudia construir nuevos módulos de máxima seguridad y revisar el uso de los tatuajes como elemento probatorio y la justicia juvenil. La tendencia trasciende a Honduras. Costa Rica trasladó el 26 de octubre a los primeros 123 reclusos a su nueva prisión de máxima seguridad, el Centro de Alta Contención y Crimen Organizado (CACCO), inspirada en el modelo salvadoreño y con capacidad para 5.100 personas. En contraste, el presidente guatemalteco Bernardo Arévalo de León vetó el miércoles 28 de octubre las reformas al Código Procesal Penal aprobadas por el Congreso de la República el 29 de septiembre, al detectar inconstitucionalidades y vacíos legales en materia de prisión preventiva, y devolvió el decreto al Legislativo . Entre las disposiciones contempladas figuraba la obligación de celebrar la audiencia de primera declaración antes de trasladar al sindicado a un centro de detención, en un plazo máximo de 24 horas. El texto también impedía ordenar la prisión preventiva sin un auto de procesamiento y motivos racionales suficientes para vincular al imputado con un hecho delictivo, y establecía que la libertad solo debía restringirse en los límites indispensables para garantizar su presencia en el proceso penal.

items.title: Qué se sabe sobre las posibles causas del accidente de tren en Toledo, España
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: Al menos 69 muertos y decenas de heridos deja el choque de dos trenes de alta velocidad en Urda, en la provincia española de Toledo.
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — El accidente entre dos trenes de alta velocidad ocurrido el miércoles en la provincia española de Toledo dejó al menos 69 personas fallecidas y decenas de heridas, según el último balance oficial difundido por las autoridades de Castilla-La Mancha. Ver más: Sánchez promete investigar el choque de trenes en España que dejó al menos 68 muertos tras una orden errónea La colisión se produjo en la línea ferroviaria que conecta Madrid con Sevilla y Andalucía, y las causas continúan bajo investigación. El siniestro ocurrió alrededor de las 8:53, hora local del 28 de octubre, a la altura de la estación de Urda. Según la reconstrucción preliminar presentada por el ministro de Transportes de España, Óscar Puente, un tren de alta velocidad de Renfe chocó por detrás contra un convoy de la compañía Iryo, que permanecía detenido en la vía. Más de 500 personas viajaban en ambos trenes. El impacto provocó graves daños en los convoyes y obligó a desplegar equipos de emergencia, personal sanitario y efectivos de la Guardia Civil. Este jueves 29 de octubre, las autoridades españolas continuaban con las labores de identificación de las víctimas y la atención a los heridos, mientras los investigadores trabajaban para esclarecer lo ocurrido. Las primeras hipótesis se centran en una avería del sistema de seguridad ferroviaria LZB y en las decisiones adoptadas después por el centro de control de circulación de Adif, el administrador público de las infraestructuras ferroviarias españolas. Ver más: Choque entre dos trenes de alta velocidad en España deja al menos 68 muertos Según explicó Puente, el sistema LZB dejó de funcionar alrededor de las 8:30, lo que provocó la detención automática de varios trenes en un tramo de unos 63 kilómetros. Seis minutos después, el centro de control autorizó al tren de Renfe a reanudar la marcha, aunque el convoy de Iryo seguía detenido más adelante. El ministro señaló que la autorización se dio sin que se hubiera restablecido el sistema de seguridad y sin aplicar, de acuerdo con su explicación, las condiciones de circulación que correspondían a esa situación. El tren de Renfe recorrió unos 25 kilómetros antes de alcanzar al de Iryo, alrededor de las 8:53. Puente calificó de “inexplicable” la decisión de permitir que el tren reanudara su recorrido en esas circunstancias. No obstante, evitó atribuir responsabilidades individuales antes de que concluya la investigación. El LZB es un sistema de protección ferroviaria utilizado en la línea de alta velocidad entre Madrid y Sevilla. Permite la comunicación continua entre la infraestructura y el tren para supervisar las condiciones de circulación, los límites de velocidad y la distancia hasta los puntos en los que debe reducirse la marcha o detenerse. Cuando funciona correctamente, el sistema puede intervenir en el frenado si detecta que el tren supera la velocidad permitida o no cumple las indicaciones de circulación. La línea también dispone de otros mecanismos de protección, entre ellos el ASFA, un sistema de anuncio de señales y frenado automático cuya supervisión es más limitada. Sin embargo, la investigación deberá determinar qué sistemas estaban operativos tras la avería, qué protección tenía el tren de Renfe y cuáles eran las condiciones que debían aplicarse antes de autorizar su movimiento. El ingeniero Óscar Carballo, secretario general del Colegio de Ingenieros Técnicos de Obras Públicas, explicó a RNE que los sistemas de señalización y frenado están diseñados para impedir que un error de conducción derive en una colisión. “Como ingeniero, diría que es imposible que un tren de alta velocidad alcance a otro. Si funcionan correctamente los sistemas de seguridad, de señalización y de frenado, no debería de haber pasado”, dijo Carballo al medio español. El presidente Pedro Sánchez escribió en X que España está de luto y advirtió: “Si ha habido negligencias o fallos, se sabrá. Y se actuará con contundencia”. Los reyes Felipe VI y Letizia cancelaron su agenda y visitaron el jueves por la tarde a los heridos en el Hospital Universitario de Toledo. El monarca subrayó que “hay, evidentemente, una investigación en marcha. Esta investigación debe determinar cómo y por qué ha sucedido esta catástrofe. Tendrán que estudiarse medidas que hay que adoptar para que esto no vuelva a suceder”. La oposición exigió responsabilidades. El líder del Partido Popular, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, viajó a Urda y afirmó que “más de 100 muertos en 8 meses en el mismo corredor” —en referencia al accidente de Adamuz (Córdoba) del pasado enero— “conlleva un cuestionamiento de nuestro actual sistema ferroviario”. Su partido pidió la comparecencia urgente de Sánchez en el Congreso, donde el ministro Puente declarará el martes 3 de noviembre ante la Diputación Permanente. El sindicato de maquinistas Semaf convocó nuevas huelgas para exigir mejoras de seguridad y cuestionó el retraso en la sustitución del LZB por el sistema europeo ERTMS en la línea. Desde formaciones de izquierda, Ada Colau e Irene Montero consideraron “injusto” e “indecente” atribuir la tragedia a un trabajador. La circulación en la línea de alta velocidad Madrid-Andalucía permanece interrumpida en ambos sentidos y Renfe suspendió la venta de billetes en esa ruta hasta diciembre. Sánchez anunció tres días de luto (29, 30 y 31 de octubre). Durante este periodo, la bandera nacional ondeará a media asta en los edificios públicos, las representaciones diplomáticas españolas en el exterior y los buques de la Armada.

items.title: Churchill River energy agreement with Quebec not open for renegotiation, says N.L.
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador’s premier says an agreement with Quebec to develop energy in Labrador is not open for renegotiation.
items.body: ST. JOHN’S — Newfoundland and Labrador’s premier says an agreement with Quebec to develop energy in Labrador is not open for renegotiation. Tony Wakeham said Wednesday that the Newfoundland and Labrador government had already voted in favour of the non-binding agreement, which he unveiled in August alongside Prime Minister Mark Carney and former Quebec premier Christine Fréchette in St. John’s, N.L. “Let me be clear: we will not be renegotiating the deal, and will not entertain an attempt by anyone else wishing to renegotiate the deal,” he said. He made the remarks as reporters pressed him about whether final agreements would be signed before they were debated in the legislature. But there is also a new Parti Québécois government in Quebec that could ask for changes to the multibillion-dollar agreement. Wakeham said he has not heard any rumblings about Quebec Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon wanting changes. “I think what I’m trying to do is just outline our position,” Wakeham told reporters in St. John’s. The proposal — which the government has called a definitive co-operation and implementation agreement — lays out plans for Hydro-Québec and Newfoundland and Labrador Hydro to expand the hydroelectric capacity of the Churchill River, which cuts through traditional Innu territory. Carney has touted the proposal as “the largest clean energy investment in North American history” and his government has promised $10 billion in financing to help it along. In a Facebook post Wednesday, the grand chief of the Innu Nation in Labrador said Innu were not included in the energy negotiations despite the agreement proposing projects on Innu land. Jodie Ashini pointed to a social media post by Carney saying he met with Wakeham recently in Ottawa, and a public statement from Wakeham pledging to “keep engaging respectfully with the Innu Nation.” “How is meeting with the prime minister and discussing our lands and not having us at the table respectful?” she wrote. “There is no respect from the (Newfoundland and Labrador) government right now to the Innu.” “Come to Sheshatshiu and speak with us,” she added, referring to an Innu community in central Labrador where the Innu Nation has its main office. Ashini has accused Wakeham and his government of interfering with a cultural exhibit detailing Innu history in Labrador. She says the government believes Innu arrived about 300 years ago, after the Europeans. The position erases thousands of years of Innu history, she has said. On Wednesday, Wakeham said he would table all final energy agreements in the legislature and propose a special debate about them. He would not answer directly when reporters asked if those agreements would already be signed, but he was clear they would not be open for changes. The Parti Québécois did not immediately respond to a request for comment. St-Pierre Plamondon and his cabinet were sworn in last week, and Wakeham has not yet met with the new premier in person. “It’s coming,” Wakeham said. “He wants to come to Newfoundland and Labrador for a meeting. He indicated that to me in our last conversation, and I’m looking forward to that.” This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 29, 2026. Sarah Smellie, The Canadian Press

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anhata Rooprai　Max A. Cherney

[２９日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Anhata Rooprai　Max A. Cherney

[２９日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手インテルが２９日発表した第４・四半期（１０─１２期）の利益・売上高見通しは市場予想を下回った。イスラエルでの工場爆発事故や長期にわたるパソコン（ＰＣ）市場の減速が、人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバー向けチップに対する堅調な需要を相殺した。時間外取引で同社の株価は２０％超下落した。

インテルは、第4・四半期の売上高は１５０億─１６０億ドルとの見通しを示し、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの平均予想の１７０億７０００万ドルを下回った。調整後１株当たり利益見通しは０．２５ドルと、予想の０．４３ドルを下回った。

デービッド・ジンスナー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターとのインタビューで、「今後、ＰＣ市場の減速は少なくとも来年前半まで続くとみている。供給を増やし、将来の成長を支えるため、生産能力と運転資本への規律ある投資を継続していく」と述べた。

また、イスラエルのキリヤット・ガットにある工場で１０月に発生した爆発事故により、第4・四半期の売上高見通しが約３億ドル、売上総利益率が約２００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）押し下げられたと推計していると説明。その上で、第１・四半期にも売上高に同程度の影響が出るとみていると述べた。

同社は、２０２６年の設備投資見通しを２００億ドルとし、７月時点の１８０億ドルから引き上げた。生産能力拡大に向け、２７年の投資額は大幅に増加するとの見通しを示した。

併せて発表した第３・四半期（９月２６日終了）の売上高は、前年同期比２１％増の１６５億１０００万ドルと、市場予想の１６５億ドルとほぼ一致した。調整後１株当たり利益は０．５２ドルと、市場予想の０．４０ドルを上回った。

ＰＣ向けチップ事業の売上高は５％減の８１億ドルと、市場予想の８９億８０００万ドルを下回った。

Patrick Stewart, Shakespearean actor turned ‘Star Trek’ and ‘X-Men’ star, dies at 86

By Will Dunham
Oct 29 (Reuters) – Patrick Stewart, who rose from poverty in England to become an accomplished Shakespearean stage actor and then achieved global stardom as the erudite Captain Jean-Luc Picard in TV’s “Star Trek: The Next Generation” and the telepathic Professor Charles Xavier in the “X-Men” movies, has died at the age of 86.

Stewart, knighted in 2010 by Queen Elizabeth II for his contributions to drama, died at his home in Los Angeles, according to a statement on his X account.

“We announce with great sorrow the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart yesterday at his home in Los Angeles, in the loving care of his beloved wife Sunny following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer’s Disease and Lewy Body Dementia,” it said.

Show Full Article

Stewart became an actor at age 18 and gained acclaim on the stage as a member of the Royal Shakespeare Company beginning in the 1960s. But it was not until after he was hired at age 47 for “Star Trek: The Next Generation” – a TV series that ran from 1987 to 1994 as a sequel to the original 1960s “Star Trek” – that he gained mainstream fame, acting into his 80s.

“Make it so,” his character Picard often said, instructing a subordinate to carry out a command, or sometimes deploying the similar catch phrase, “Engage.”

It was a role he had debated even taking after his longtime friend and fellow Shakespearen Ian McKellen advised him to spurn “Star Trek” and remain in theater. Stewart did take the role and became both a fan favorite and an indispensable part of a lucrative sci-fi franchise, playing Picard not only in 176 episodes over seven seasons of that series but also in several “Star Trek” films and in the later streaming series “Star Trek: Picard” that began airing in 2020 when he was 79.

“As the seven seasons of TNG (“The Next Generation”) went by, the distinction between Jean-Luc Picard and Patrick Stewart became thinner and thinner, until it was impossible for me to know where he left off and I began. So much of what I believed and felt went into that show,” Stewart told the Guardian newspaper in 2022.

Stewart also initially balked at being cast as the wheelchair-using mutant Professor X in the “X-Men” movies, based on the popular Marvel comic book character.

“I said, ‘Look, I know this isn’t science fiction, but it’s fantasy, and I’ve done that.’ But they persuaded me that it wouldn’t be like ‘Star Trek,’ so I did it. And yet again I was proved wrong,” Stewart told the Guardian.

He became a critical part of another big-money franchise starting with the first entry “X-Men” in 2000 and followed by several more.

ACTING WAS SAFE SPACE

Stewart was born on July 13, 1940, in the English town of Mirfield in Yorkshire. He was raised in poverty, with a father who he said returned from World War Two an alcoholic who suffered from post-traumatic stress syndrome and physically abused Stewart’s mother. Stewart recalled putting his body between his father and mother to try to protect her.

As a child, Stewart said, acting became a “safe space” after a schoolteacher introduced him to Shakespeare – specifically “The Merchant of Venice” – during a class when he was 12. He started losing his hair at age 17 and was bald by 19. He was embarrassed at the time, but eventually embraced it.

“Star Trek,” created by Gene Roddenberry, presented a hopeful vision of the future, with humankind venturing into the cosmos in spaceships exceeding the speed of light and encountering alien races. The enduring popularity of the original series and the success of spinoff films prompted Roddenberry to create “The Next Generation” sequel series.

The Picard character was the opposite of the swashbuckling and sometimes unintentionally buffoonish Captain James T. Kirk, played by William Shatner, of the original series – envisioned as more cerebral and disciplined, though sometimes coming across as stuffy, humorless, or self-important.

Stewart recalled being a little bit too serious toward his cast mates early on.

“I tell the story of calling a meeting of my principal fellow cast members and telling them that I thought we were not disciplined enough, that we should not be fooling about on the set as much as we were but taking everything seriously,” Stewart told the New Yorker in 2023.

“And one of the cast members said, ‘Oh, come on, Patrick, we’ve got to have some fun.’ And I thumped the chair and said, ‘We are not here to have fun’ – which they have never let me forget. They taught me so much about loosening up and being freer,” Stewart added.

Stewart also felt the series improved as it went along, faulting his own portrayal of Picard in the first two seasons.

“I found it lacking intimacy. It was very authoritative, but there were few other qualities in him,” Stewart said, adding that his work got better in subsequent seasons.

In fact, the finest work for the entire cast may have been the two-part, time-bending series finale.

He became Sir Patrick Stewart when he was knighted by the queen at Buckingham Palace in 2010. He told reporters that his heroes were British actors Laurence Olivier, John Gielgud and Alec Guinness, who also had been knighted, adding that being “in that company is the grandest thing that has professionally happened to me.”

Stewart was married three times and had two children. His third marriage, in 2013, was to American musician Sunny Ozell.

(Reporting by Will Dunham in Washington; Additional reporting by Ryan Patrick Jones and Christian Martinez; Editing by Diane Craft and Rosalba O’Brien)

第３・四半期（７─９月）決算は、クラウドコンピューティング部門「アマゾン・ウェブ・サービス（ＡＷＳ）」の売上高が前年比３９％増の４６０億ドル。伸びは第２・四半期の３７％からやや加速した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめた市場予想は３８．２％増の４５６億１０００万ドルだった。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝反落、アルファベット決算受けＡＩ投資に警戒
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　２９日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　２９日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反落した。注目企業の決算や重要なインフレ指標を消化する中で、投資家は大手テクノロジー企業による巨額のＡＩ（人工知能）投資を見直した。

主要３株価指数はいずれも下落。２８日に発表されたアルファベットの低調な四半期決算を受け、テクノロジー株比率の高いナスダックの下げが最も大きかった。一方、小型株で構成するラッセル２０００指数は１．０％上昇した。

半導体株は５営業日ぶりに反落。野心的なＡＩ投資の資金を自力で賄える企業と、手元資金を取り崩し借り入れに頼る企業を選別する動きが広がった。

アルファベットは前日の決算発表を受けて後者と見なされた。中核の検索広告事業が振るわず売上高が市場予想を下回ったほか、ＡＩ関連の資金流出も大幅に拡大した。株価は１２．６％急落し、通信サービス指数を押し下げた。

ベアードの投資戦略アナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「こうしたリスク回避の日に小型株が相対的に好調なのは、ＡＩの成長シナリオにほころびが見えても市場全体に問題が広がるわけではないと、市場が今のところ受け止めていることを示す良い兆候だ」と指摘。「ＡＩ関連株以外にも、かなり有望な投資先は数多くある」と述べた。

米商務省が発表した第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比年率３．４％増加し、市場予想を上回った。底堅い個人消費とＡＩ関連の企業投資が、中東紛争に伴う原油価格上昇の影響を補い、成長率は１年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。また、９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、８月の３．４％上昇から伸びが加速した。　

重機大手キャタピラーは９．３％下落。四半期利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、成長目標を据え置いた。

一方、第３・四半期売上高が市場予想を上回ったフォード・モーターは１２．４％上昇した。

製薬大手イーライ・リリーは６．６％高。肥満症治療薬の好調な販売を受け、売上高見通しを引き上げた。

メルクも３．８％上昇。がん治療薬「キイトルーダ」とヒトパピローマウイルス（ＨＰＶ）ワクチン「ガーダシル」の販売が好調で、利益が市場予想を上回った。

ソフトウエア株は総じて軟調で、フォーティネットとサービスナウは四半期決算発表後にいずれも２０％超下落した。 

半導体大手マーベル・テクノロジーは１３．２％下落。データセンター向け光学部品を手がけるルメンタム・ホールディングスの買収に向け、詰めの協議を進めていると報じられた。ルメンタムは０．６％上昇した。 

アマゾン・ドット・コムは第４・四半期の売上高見通しが失望を誘い、時間外取引で６．５％下落した。 

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．９５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０７対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１７０億５０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７０億９０００万株。

ベアードの投資戦略アナリスト、ロス・メイフィールド氏は「こうしたリスク回避の日に小型株が相対的に好調なのは、ＡＩの成長シナリオにほころびが見えても市場全体に問題が広がるわけではないと、市場が今のところ受け止めていることを示す良い兆候だ」と指摘。「ＡＩ関連株以外にも、かなり有望な投資先は数多くある」と述べた。

米商務省が発表した第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）速報値は前期比年率３．４％増加し、市場予想を上回った。底堅い個人消費とＡＩ関連の企業投資が、中東紛争に伴う原油価格上昇の影響を補い、成長率は１年ぶりの高い伸びとなった。また、９月の個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数は前年比３．６％上昇し、８月の３．４％上昇から伸びが加速した。　

重機大手キャタピラーは９．３％下落。四半期利益が市場予想を上回ったものの、成長目標を据え置いた。

一方、第３・四半期売上高が市場予想を上回ったフォード・モーターは１２．４％上昇した。

製薬大手イーライ・リリーは６．６％高。肥満症治療薬の好調な販売を受け、売上高見通しを引き上げた。

メルクも３．８％上昇。がん治療薬「キイトルーダ」とヒトパピローマウイルス（ＨＰＶ）ワクチン「ガーダシル」の販売が好調で、利益が市場予想を上回った。

ソフトウエア株は総じて軟調で、フォーティネットとサービスナウは四半期決算発表後にいずれも２０％超下落した。 

半導体大手マーベル・テクノロジーは１３．２％下落。データセンター向け光学部品を手がけるルメンタム・ホールディングスの買収に向け、詰めの協議を進めていると報じられた。ルメンタムは０．６％上昇した。 

アマゾン・ドット・コムは第４・四半期の売上高見通しが失望を誘い、時間外取引で６．５％下落した。 

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．９５対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでも１．０７対１で値上がり銘柄が多かった。

米取引所の合算出来高は約１７０億５０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７０億９０００万株。

Oct 29 : Cryptocurrency exchange Coinbase Global reported a quarterly profit on Thursday, snapping a three-quarter-long streak of losses, driven by lower operating expenses.
Total operating expenses in the third quarter fell about 17 per cent to $1.15 billion, compared with $1.39 billion for the same period in the prior year.
Cryptocurrency trading activity has struggled to regain momentum this year as investors grappled with shifting monetary policy expectations, weaker flows into digital asset investment products and periodic market volatility.
Transaction revenue dropped 43 per cent to $590.2 million during the quarter, from $1.05 billion a year earlier.
The company reported a profit of $718.7 million, or $2.51 per share, for the quarter ended September 30, compared with $432.6 million, or $1.50 per share, a year earlier.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Walmart said on Thursday it had extended its agreement with AI robotics firm Symbotic, committing about $6 billion over several years to bring more automation capabilities to its distribution network.
Symbotic has been helping Walmart automate its supply chain since 2017.
Under the agreement, Symbotic will bring additional automation capabilities to 25 of Walmart's regional distribution centers in the US and support its supply chain capabilities globally.
Walmart said the agreement aimed to support its e-commerce upstream inventory management, increase storage capacity and improve how products move through the supply chain.
These capabilities will help Walmart offer customers a broader assortment, improve speed and provide more reliable replenishment across its network, the retailer said.
Retailers are increasingly deploying chatbots, along with targeted promotions and loyalty programs to entice shoppers who often turn to AI for product recommendations.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Oct 29 : Reddit CEO Steve Huffman outlined a plan on Thursday to make signing-in mandatory for most content as the company grapples with data scraping and declining search referral traffic in recent months.
Huffman warned that total daily active unique visitors (DAUq) could fall by a low double-digit percentage in the fourth quarter from about 130 million currently, if search referral traffic continues to decline further. Shares of the company fell more than 9 per cent in extended trading.
Search engine referrals to Reddit decreased by more than one million on average each week during October, he said. In the US, its biggest market by revenue, DAUq fell 2 per cent to 50.7 million.
Reddit, which licenses its data to OpenAI and Alphabet's Google, has sued IPO-bound Anthropic, Perplexity AI and three data scraping companies, accusing them of illegally collecting Reddit's data.

Oct 29 : Amazon.com on Thursday reported a massive cash burn in the third quarter and forecast holiday-quarter revenue largely below Wall Street estimates, sending shares lower.
Investors soured on the company, driving shares down nearly 7 per cent in extended trading. The shares had declined 4.3 per cent in regular trading to end at $243.79.
The Seattle-based retailer expects revenue of between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion in the fourth quarter, compared with analysts' average estimate of $244.51 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company said it burned $42.4 billion on a trailing 12-month basis in the September quarter, driven by capital expenditure of $77.26 billion which was some $20 billion above estimates, according to data compiled by LSEG.
Amazon reported cash burn of $7.6 billion in the prior quarter, and generated $14.8 billion in the third quarter of last year.

"The free cash flow looks like the ugly part of the report," said Dave Wagner, portfolio manager at Aptus Capital Advisors. "Operations generated plenty of cash but their capex just absolutely swallowed it."
"The trend is pretty steep and pretty negative, and that's the big thing that is alarming in this report."
Like competitors, Amazon has made a huge spending commitment to developing AI software and infrastructure, forecasting $220 billion in capital expenditures this year. Amazon and Google parent Alphabet have maintained their spending expectations, though Microsoft on Wednesday lowered its own to $170 billion from $175 billion.
Jesse Cohen, a senior analyst at Investing.com, also pointed to Amazon's free cash flow and "weak guidance" as reasons for the share decline. "Amazon's third-quarter report landed as a double disappointment."
CLOUD BUSINESS DRIVES GROWTH
Revenue at Amazon Web Services rose 39 per cent to $46 billion in the third quarter ended September, compared with analysts' estimate for a 38.2 per cent increase to $45.61 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. AWS revenue recorded a 37 per cent jump in the second quarter.
The company also maintained its annual capital spending forecast of about $220 billion.
Advertising sales were another disappointment, rising just 12 per cent to $19.6 billion from a year earlier, below the 18 per cent estimate from LSEG — the first time it missed analyst estimates in seven quarters. The results marked much slower growth than the second quarter's 26 per cent or the 2025 third quarter's 22 per cent.
The downbeat fourth-quarter outlook signals US retailers could face pain in the holiday season, as consumers tighten shopping budgets amid higher gasoline prices and the rising cost of living.
Still, recent industry forecasts predict holiday sales will accelerate from last year. The National Retail Federation earlier this month predicted a 4.2 per cent jump in total US holiday season sales.
While retail sales account for the majority of Amazon's revenue, investor focus has shifted sharply toward its cloud computing business, Amazon Web Services, in recent years, as the tech company spends heavily to build out data centers and compete in the global AI race.
Amazon's cloud unit grew at its fastest pace in nearly five years.
At its e-commerce business, Amazon has been rolling out faster delivery services globally and expanding to more rural areas in the US to draw more shoppers.

Source: Reuters

Oct 29 : Intel shares plunged 14 per cent on Thursday after the chipmaker said a deadly explosion at its Israel factory would erase roughly $600 million in revenue over two quarters, with the full financial fallout still uncertain.
The US chipmaker also warned of flagging PC revenue through the first half of next year, as exponential increases in memory prices have weighed on sales. If the stock were to lose this much ground in Friday's session, Intel would shed over $80 billion in market value.
The gloomy outlook reverberated across the chip sector, sending Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD, Micron, Qualcomm and Arm Holdings' US-listed shares between 1 per cent and 6 per cent lower in extended trading.
The October explosion at its Kiryat Gat, Israel factory, or fab, killed two and seriously injured one, according to local media reports. Finance chief David Zinsner said Intel planned to start ramping up production at the facility by the end of this week after a two-week shutdown.

The company said the fourth-quarter revenue outlook would be reduced by roughly $300 million and its gross margins by about 200 basis points, Zinsner said in an interview with Reuters. He said the company expects a similar revenue impact in the first quarter. 
Intel is in the process of determining which wafers are salvageable for use and sale after the blast. 
"We're still assessing all of the wafers to see which ones are usable and which ones aren't, so we'll have to see whether there is an impact that stretches beyond that," Zinsner said.
The Kiryat Gat fab largely produces data center chips using the company's 10 nanometer manufacturing process.
"The explosion at Kiryat Gat, one of Intel’s major manufacturing sites, is unfortunate and brought down Intel’s capacity," Hendi Susanto, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said. "The question is whether Intel can build capacity fast enough to capture it."
SLOWING PC SALES
Intel's forecast could test investor confidence in a stock that has more than doubled this year, as investors weigh ongoing manufacturing constraints and soft PC demand against strong demand for its AI server chips and efforts to revive growth through a costly foundry expansion. Zinsner said he expects the PC slowdown will continue through the first half of next year.
The company expects PC revenue to decline in the mid-twenty percentage range for its fourth quarter, Zinsner said in the interview.
Sales in Intel's PC chip business fell 5 per cent to $8.10 billion, missing estimates of $8.98 billion. Investors have been watching for signs that demand has stabilized despite the company's expectation for a soft personal-computing market in the second half of this year and into 2027.
"Client computing is still a big factor in Intel's earnings so while it is likely short-term, it will still impact earnings for the near term and I think that's the biggest issue," said Anshel Sag, an analyst at Moor Insights & Strategy.
The results also put a spotlight on Intel's funding plans. In August, the company raised $23 billion from an upsized share offering, as it seeks to challenge industry leaders such as TSMC in contract chip manufacturing. 
Intel expects fourth-quarter revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Adjusted profit is expected to be 25 cents per share, trailing estimates of 43 cents.
TURNAROUND PLANS
The company had also raised its 2026 capital spending forecast to $20 billion from $18 billion in July and said 2027 spending would increase significantly to expand manufacturing capacity.
CEO Lip-Bu Tan has been leading the company's turnaround after it fell behind Nvidia, whose graphics processors dominate the AI boom, with the contract manufacturing, or foundry, business a key part of his revival strategy.
In the third quarter ended September 26, revenue rose 21 per cent to $16.51 billion, largely in line with estimates of $16.50 billion. Adjusted profit came in at 52 cents per share, beating estimates of 40 cents.

Source: Reuters

Intel shares drop 14% on Israel factory blast, PC weakness

Oct 29 : Intel shares plunged 14 per cent on Thursday after the chipmaker said a deadly explosion at its Israel factory would erase roughly $600 million in revenue over two quarters, with the full financial fallout still uncertain.
The US chipmaker also warned of flagging PC revenue through the first half of next year, as exponential increases in memory prices have weighed on sales. If the stock were to lose this much ground in Friday's session, Intel would shed over $80 billion in market value.
The gloomy outlook reverberated across the chip sector, sending Nvidia, Broadcom, AMD, Micron, Qualcomm and Arm Holdings' US-listed shares between 1 per cent and 6 per cent lower in extended trading.
The October explosion at its Kiryat Gat, Israel factory, or fab, killed two and seriously injured one, according to local media reports. Finance chief David Zinsner said Intel planned to start ramping up production at the facility by the end of this week after a two-week shutdown.

The company said the fourth-quarter revenue outlook would be reduced by roughly $300 million and its gross margins by about 200 basis points, Zinsner said in an interview with Reuters. He said the company expects a similar revenue impact in the first quarter. 
Intel is in the process of determining which wafers are salvageable for use and sale after the blast. 
"We're still assessing all of the wafers to see which ones are usable and which ones aren't, so we'll have to see whether there is an impact that stretches beyond that," Zinsner said.
The Kiryat Gat fab largely produces data center chips using the company's 10 nanometer manufacturing process.
"The explosion at Kiryat Gat, one of Intel’s major manufacturing sites, is unfortunate and brought down Intel’s capacity," Hendi Susanto, portfolio manager at Gabelli Funds, said. "The question is whether Intel can build capacity fast enough to capture it."
SLOWING PC SALES
Intel's forecast could test investor confidence in a stock that has more than doubled this year, as investors weigh ongoing manufacturing constraints and soft PC demand against strong demand for its AI server chips and efforts to revive growth through a costly foundry expansion. Zinsner said he expects the PC slowdown will continue through the first half of next year.
The company expects PC revenue to decline in the mid-twenty percentage range for its fourth quarter, Zinsner said in the interview.
Sales in Intel's PC chip business fell 5 per cent to $8.10 billion, missing estimates of $8.98 billion. Investors have been watching for signs that demand has stabilized despite the company's expectation for a soft personal-computing market in the second half of this year and into 2027.
"Client computing is still a big factor in Intel's earnings so while it is likely short-term, it will still impact earnings for the near term and I think that's the biggest issue," said Anshel Sag, an analyst at Moor Insights & Strategy.
The results also put a spotlight on Intel's funding plans. In August, the company raised $23 billion from an upsized share offering, as it seeks to challenge industry leaders such as TSMC in contract chip manufacturing. 
Intel expects fourth-quarter revenue between $15 billion and $16 billion, below analysts' average estimate of $17.07 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Adjusted profit is expected to be 25 cents per share, trailing estimates of 43 cents.
TURNAROUND PLANS
The company had also raised its 2026 capital spending forecast to $20 billion from $18 billion in July and said 2027 spending would increase significantly to expand manufacturing capacity.
CEO Lip-Bu Tan has been leading the company's turnaround after it fell behind Nvidia, whose graphics processors dominate the AI boom, with the contract manufacturing, or foundry, business a key part of his revival strategy.
In the third quarter ended September 26, revenue rose 21 per cent to $16.51 billion, largely in line with estimates of $16.50 billion. Adjusted profit came in at 52 cents per share, beating estimates of 40 cents.

Source: Reuters

items.author: Daniel Moss

items.summary: After a lean few years, Thailand’s economy is showing signs of improvement. Deflation has given way to inflation of almost 3%, while policymakers are upgrading growth forecasts. With the recovery still modest, however, officials have little reason to rush: Absent a major upheaval, they can take their time lifting interest rates from historically low levels.It's an encouraging picture — but one that tells only part of the story.

items.title: Iran Receives Vance Letter, Signals No Shift in Peace Deal Terms
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: Iran received a letter sent by US Vice President JD Vance to its top security official, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, with one of the country’s top negotiators later suggesting Tehran’s positions on ending the war will not be compromised.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- Iran received a letter sent by US Vice President JD Vance to its top security official, the semi-official Tasnim news agency reported, with one of the country’s top negotiators later suggesting Tehran’s positions on ending the war will not be compromised. Tasnim didn’t disclose the contents of the letter addressed to Mohsen Rezaee, the hardline chief of the Supreme National Security Council, or say whether Tehran is preparing a reply. But in a post on X after the letter was reportedly received, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, one of Iran’s negotiators in previous talks to end the war, wrote that “Iran’s conditions have been repeatedly and clearly stated to the mediators.” “The carrot-and-stick approach has no effect on Iran,” Ghalibaf continued without mentioning Vance’s letter or saying if his comments constituted a formal reply. The highly unusual approach by Vance comes as President Donald Trump repeatedly threatens to resume airstrikes on Iran amid an impasse in negotiations to end the eight-month war. Trump told reporters on Wednesday he authorized Vance to contact Tehran, saying the letter was meant to assist Iran with “medical supplies and various things,” without providing specifics.The Wall Street Journal earlier reported that Vance had written to Rezaee in a bid to revive peace negotiations. The development follows high-level talks in Tehran this week with officials from Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan. The parties described the meeting as positive and agreed to continue discussions, though no formal second round has been set. Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei reiterated earlier this week that his country has certain conditions that must be met before an end to the war can be agreed. At the heart of the impasse is Tehran’s ongoing attacks on ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz, while the US has imposed a naval blockade on Iran’s ports. Iran has repeatedly said in recent weeks that it remains open to diplomacy, with Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi writing on X on Thursday that while “our Brave Armed Forces are fully prepared to defend the Homeland, Iran continues to give diplomacy a chance to succeed.”The US and Israel started bombing Iran in late February, triggering retaliatory strikes by Tehran on Gulf nations hosting US military bases. The war has killed thousands — mostly Iranian civilians — while disrupting energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz and roiling global markets.--With assistance from Eltaf Najafizada and Sherif Tarek.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: 米、ベネズエラ大統領選の27年実施を提案＝野党指導者マチャド氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Mayela Armas　Deisy Buitrago

[カラカス　２９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Mayela Armas　Deisy Buitrago

[カラカス　２９日　ロイター] - ベネズエラの野党指導者でノーベル平和賞受賞者のマリア・コリナ・マチャド氏は２９日、米国がベネズエラの大統領選を２０２７年に実施するよう提案していると明らかにした。

マチャド氏は２５日に約１年ぶりにベネズエラに帰国。テレビ中継された首都カラカスでの記者会見で「ここ数日の米国務省の声明は、今後取るべき措置について非常に明確だ」と述べ、その内容として新たな国家選挙評議会（ＣＮＥ）の速やかな任命、憲法上の期限の順守、２７年の大統領選実施を挙げた。

また、ルビオ米国務長官は２７年のベネズエラ大統領選実施を支持していると指摘。今後実施されるいかなる選挙でも投票資格を持つ全てのベネズエラ国民が投票できるようにすると述べた。

マチャド氏が本格的な発言を行うのは今回が帰国以来初めて。マチャド氏はこれまでも２７年の大統領選実施を支持してきた。

items.title: ロシア軍、 ウクライナ攻撃継続　ドニプロの鉄道駅で14人死亡
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Dan Peleschuk　Max Hunder

[キーウ／ドニプロ（ウクライナ）　２９日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Dan Peleschuk　Max Hunder

[キーウ／ドニプロ（ウクライナ）　２９日　ロイター] - 米国が仲介するロシアとウクライナの和平実現に向けた３国協議の再開が調整される中でも、ロシア軍はウクライナ各地への攻撃を継続し、２９日は東部ドニプロペトロウスク州の州都ドニプロの鉄道駅へのドローン（無人機）攻撃で少なくとも１４人が死亡したほか、北部チェルニヒウ州と中部ポルタワ州で合計５人が死亡した。ただ、南部ヘルソン州での局地的な停戦は維持されており、外交交渉再開への期待は消えていない。

ウクライナ国鉄によると、ドニプロではロシア軍のジェット推進式のドローンが市内の主要な鉄道駅のホームを直撃した。攻撃があった際、一般の列車が駅を出発するところだったという。現場では、破片による損傷の跡が残る舗装路面に遺体が散乱。空襲警報のサイレンが鳴り響く中、警察官らが黒い遺体袋に遺体を収容する様子が見られた。

チェルニヒウでは、市中心部の繁華街に対するドローン攻撃で１０代の少女２人が死亡し、子ども４人を含む２３人が負傷。ポルタワ州クレメンチュクでは住宅への攻撃で３人が死亡した。このほか、南東部ザポリージャでは市バスが３回にわたりドローン攻撃を受け、６人が負傷した。

新たな３カ国協議の調整が進められる中、 ウクライナのブダノフ大統領府長官ら政府高官は、ウクライナのパートナー国に対しロシアへの圧力を強めるよう求めている。ブダノフ氏はＸへの投稿で「ロシアは鉄道や駅、住宅で意図的に民間人を標的にしている」と非難。コレツキー首相も通信アプリ「テレグラム」への投稿で「このようなテロ行為を正当化する理由はなく、今後も決してあり得ない」と非難した。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

上昇して取引を終えた。石油株が買われて、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．１４％高と反発した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種石油・ガス株指数は１．６４％高。石油大手シェルは２．１％上昇。２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が２０２２年以来の高水準となったほか、自社株買い計画の拡大を発表したことから買われた。

防衛大手ＢＡＥシステムズは２．２％、エンジンメーカーのロールスロイスは１．３％、それぞれ上昇。広告大手ＷＰＰは５．４％値上がりした。

一方、製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は０．４６％安。消費者向けヘルスケア企業ヘイリオンは１５．０％下落。売上高の伸び率見通しを引き下げたことを受け、売りが膨らんだ。

銀行株指数は０．７８％下落。２６年７─９月期決算を発表した英銀大手のロイズは５．０％安。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

続伸して取引を終えた。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）による政策金利の据え置き決定を受け、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は９月８日以来の高値で引けた。堅調な企業業績も相場を支援した。

２０２６年７─９月期決算で純利益が２２年以来の高水準となった石油大手シェルは２．１％上昇。四半期決算で利益が２倍以上となったフランス石油大手トタルは１．２％高。

通期の業績見通しを維持した航空機大手エアバスは２．３％値上がりした。

直近四半期の売上高が増えたドイツの半導体製造装置メーカー、アイクストロンは８．５％高。売上高が市場予想を上回ったフランス自動車大手ルノー・グループは６．９％上昇した。

一方、ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は０．３１％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンコ・ビルバオ・ビスカヤ・アルヘンタリヤ（ＢＢＶＡ）は２．６％下落した。

ＥＣＢは金利を据え置いたものの、エネルギー価格の上昇を受けてインフレリスクが高まっているとして１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。ＥＣＢのラガルド総裁は任期途中で退任することを明らかにした。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

域内国債利回りが低下した。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）がこの日の理事会で予想通り政策金利を据え置いた中、市場はＥＣＢが１２月に利上げに踏み切るとの見方を維持した。

ＥＣＢは２９日、予想通り政策金利を据え置くと決定した。ただ、エネルギー価格の急騰を受けてインフレリスクが高まっていると警告し、１２月の利上げの可能性に含みを残した。

また同日、ＥＣＢラガルド総裁は辞意を表明し、総裁の去就を巡る数カ月にわたる臆測に終止符を打った。

市場が織り込む、ＥＣＢが１２月理事会で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを実施する確率は約７５％。また、来年に少なくとももう１回利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ低下の３．３５％。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは５ｂｐ低下の３．０６％。

フランス１０年債利回りは約１ｂｐ低下の４．９％。独仏１０年債利回り格差は約１５５ｂｐに拡大した。

items.title: Canada ‘well positioned’ to increase trade with Europe: TD report
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: As Canada looks to develop closer economic ties with the European Union (EU), a new report suggests there is billions of dollars’ worth of untapped demand for Canadian goods and services in Europe.
items.body: As Canada looks to develop closer economic ties with the European Union (EU), a new report suggests there is billions of dollars’ worth of untapped demand for Canadian goods and services in Europe. The report, published by TD Economics on Wednesday prior to the Canada-EU summit taking place in Montreal on Thursday and Friday, said current Canadian access to European markets is limited due to regulatory hurdles, geography and other factors. “These barriers notwithstanding, Canada is well positioned to increase its market share in the EU,” wrote report authors and TD economists Vikram Rai and Rishi Sondhi. They said this week’s summit is an opportunity to “build momentum and advance cooperation in priority sectors,” as Canada looks to diversify its trading partnerships amid an ongoing trade war with the U.S. “European demand increasingly overlaps with Canadian capabilities and the two sides’ strategic interest in diversifying economic ties,” the report said. “The upside for Canadian exports is meaningful. Product-level analysis suggests demand for nearly $60 billion in additional goods exports could exist, under certain conditions, including roughly $50 billion in energy.” The report listed the defence, energy, critical minerals, digital markets, and financial and other professional services sectors as those with the “largest long-term opportunities” in an expanded Canada-EU trade partnership. “The biggest gains will need to be unlocked through expanded infrastructure and deeper cooperation to expand investment, improve market access, and build new supply chains in critical areas,” it said. Trade currently limited The EU accounts for around five per cent of Canada’s total international goods exports, the report noted, roughly in line with Canadian exports to the U.K. and China. Last year, it amounted to $43 billion worth of merchandise, which was just one per cent of the EU’s total imports. “Canada’s main exports to the EU include crude oil, aircraft, aluminum, uranium, iron, canola, nickel and diamonds,” the report said. “Even with this hefty product mix, Canada typically runs a goods trade deficit with the EU. In 2025, it amounted to $50 billion, with Canada importing high-value manufactured products like pharmaceutical products, automobiles and medical instruments.” Trade, the report argues, is the “most obvious place” for Canada and the EU to deepen their economic partnership, and the report authors said there are two main ways to think about the opportunity. “The first is to look for products Canada already exports competitively but sells only in small amounts to Europe,” they said. “The second is to focus on strategic sectors – such as energy and critical minerals – where governments on both sides want to build new supply chains and deepen economic ties, even if trade is limited today.” Breaking down economic and trade barriers for goods and services is something both Prime Minister Mark Carney and European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen have advocated for as Canada and the EU discuss what a closer relationship will ultimately look like. This week’s summit may provide some answers, but there’s still a long way to go, the report authors say. “Much work will remain after the summit: securing capital and buyers, delivering timely approvals, expanding infrastructure, and easing certification and procurement barriers,” they said. “Ultimately, stronger demand, greater Canadian capacity and better market access – not a one-off diversion of trade – could make Europe a meaningfully larger export market.”

MEXICO CITY, Oct 29 : Kimi Antonelli was excused media duties on Thursday with the Mercedes driver feeling unwell ahead of a Mexico City Grand Prix weekend that is set to make him Formula One's youngest champion.  
The team said the 20-year-old Italian was recovering from a viral illness and "feeling under the weather".
"As a precaution, the FIA have excused him from his mandatory media duties to give him the chance to rest ahead of the weekend. We expect him to be back tomorrow," a spokeswoman said.
Antonelli will be champion on Sunday if he finishes in the top nine at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Sunday, even if closest rival and teammate George Russell wins the race. The Italian, who won in Texas last weekend, has a 123-point lead with five races and a maximum 125 points remaining.

items.title: Cash takes centre stage as investors rethink AI spending boom
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Investors are increasingly focused on technology companies' cash generation capabilities to fund artificial intelligence investments. Microsoft and Oracle are gaining positive attention from investors, while Alphabet faces challenges due to rising AI costs. Alphabet's spending has surpassed its operating cash flow, raising concerns about its financial sustainability. In contrast, Microsoft's strong cash flow and forecasted growth indicate effective AI investment returns.
items.body: Investors are drawing a sharper line between technology companies that can fund their artificial intelligence ambitions through cash generation and those whose spending is outpacing their operating income. Microsoft and Oracle have won favour on Wall Street, while Alphabet faces pressure as rising AI costs collide with slower growth in its core search business, Reuters reported.Alphabet shares fell over 13% on Thursday while Oracle slipped 4% and Microsoft was down 0.45% at 3:48 pm ET.The divergence signals a shift in investor priorities, with spending alone no longer enough to justify lofty AI expectations.For live updates on US Markets, click here Alphabet’s AI spending outpaces cash generationAlphabet spent 121.4% of its operating cash flow on capital expenditure in the September quarter, compared with 68% for Microsoft, excluding finance leases, according to Reuters. Spending above 100% means a company must rely on cash reserves or borrowing to cover the shortfall.Google’s search revenue grew 12%, missing market expectations of 14.7%, even as CEO Sundar Pichai said search queries were growing at their fastest pace in five years. The slowdown has raised concerns that AI chatbots and agents could challenge the business funding Alphabet’s expansion.Also Read: Alphabet’s AI risks deepen as filing reveals $98 billion in commitments beyond the $1 trillion spendingAlphabet’s capital expenditure could reach $205 billion this year, while Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.71 billion. However, its cash burn reached $9.07 billion, underscoring the strain of its investment programme, Reuters reported.“Microsoft's quarter demonstrated very disciplined growth, whereas Google is burning cash and its core business came in below expectations,” said Melissa Otto, head of research at S&P Global Visible Alpha.Microsoft demonstrates returns from AI investmentMicrosoft generated $18.6 billion in free cash flow in its fiscal first quarter, nearly $10 billion above Wall Street expectations, despite spending $45.2 billion on computing infrastructure. Azure revenue surged 48%, while the company forecast stronger cloud growth for the current quarter, Reuters reported.Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said businesses were moving beyond experimentation with AI towards longer-term commitments.“The shiny object stuff is waning,” Nadella said during an analyst call.Oracle’s plans to curb external financing further reinforced the market’s focus on cash generation, suggesting investors increasingly want evidence that AI investments can support themselves rather than depend on continued borrowing. (Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)
